data.evidence_sentence: Awarded annually to a Canadian citizen or permanent resident with superior academic standing (GPA of 3.5 or greater on a course load of 30 credits) who is being admitted to the first year of a Master of Business Administration degree program in the Faculty of Business.
data.notes: Canadian citizen or permanent resident is stated as ONLY Canada; permanent residence status is included in the eligibility text, so nationality_rule kept as ONLY:Canada without the qualifier. Community involvement and student association participation may be considered (preference, not requirement). Award is for students being admitted to MBA first year; applicant status used. Study mode is full-time or part-time, so neither is restricted. No application deadline stated on the page. Funding amount and type not stated.
